# TimeStamp { #timetoalign.TimeStamp }

```python
TimeStamp(axis, source, source_id, row_index=-1, conversion_maps=True)
```

A synchronized instant across a timeline hierarchy.

Lightweight object that computes coordinates on access via InterpolationMaps.
Works identically for Timeline (with children) and TimelineGroup (with members).

The TimeStamp represents a cross-section through the timeline structure at
a specific axis coordinate. All related timelines' coordinates can be
retrieved via get() or subscript access.

## Attributes {.doc-section .doc-section-attributes}

| Name      | Type                                                            | Description                                              |
|-----------|-----------------------------------------------------------------|----------------------------------------------------------|
| axis      | [float](`float`)                                                | The root/reference coordinate value.                     |
| source    | [TimeStampSource](`timetoalign.core.timestamp.TimeStampSource`) | The Timeline or TimelineGroup this timestamp belongs to. |
| source_id | [str](`str`)                                                    | ID of the source (for serialization).                    |
| row_index | [int](`int`)                                                    | If from a table row, the index. -1 if interpolated.      |

## Examples {.doc-section .doc-section-examples}

```python
>>> ts = timeline.get_timestamp(5.0)
>>> ts.axis  # The root coordinate
5.0
>>> ts["child:1"]  # Get coordinate on child timeline
2.5
>>> ts.get("child:2", default=0.0)  # With default
0.0
```

```python
>>> # Convert to different unit
>>> ts.get_unit(TimeUnit.seconds)
10.5
```

## Methods

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [get](#timetoalign.TimeStamp.get) | Get coordinate on another timeline. |
| [get_conversion](#timetoalign.TimeStamp.get_conversion) | Get the raw output of a conversion map addressed by name/selector. |

### get { #timetoalign.TimeStamp.get }

```python
TimeStamp.get(timeline_id, default=None)
```

Get coordinate on another timeline.

Returns ``default`` (None) when the queried coordinate falls
outside the related timeline's span -- for instance, asking a
child whose parent-side interval is ``[10, 30)`` for the
coordinate at axis 5.

For `Timeline` sources, child coordinates are resolved via exact
offset arithmetic (no interpolation). For `TimelineGroup` sources,
coordinates are resolved via `InterpolationMap`.

#### Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name        | Type                     | Description                                               | Default    |
|-------------|--------------------------|-----------------------------------------------------------|------------|
| timeline_id | [str](`str`)             | The timeline to get coordinate for.                       | _required_ |
| default     | [float](`float`) \| None | Value to return if timeline not reachable or out of span. | `None`     |

#### Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type                     | Description                                            |
|--------|--------------------------|--------------------------------------------------------|
|        | [float](`float`) \| None | Coordinate on the target timeline, or *default* if not |
|        | [float](`float`) \| None | reachable or the axis is outside the target's span.    |

### get_conversion { #timetoalign.TimeStamp.get_conversion }

```python
TimeStamp.get_conversion(key)
```

Get the raw output of a conversion map addressed by name/selector.

Searches the source and every descendant/member present at this axis
for a C-Map whose name, id, selector, or target-unit name is *key*, and
evaluates it at that timeline's coordinate.

#### Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name   | Type         | Description                                               | Default    |
|--------|--------------|-----------------------------------------------------------|------------|
| key    | [str](`str`) | A conversion-map name, id, selector, or target-unit name. | _required_ |

#### Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type                | Description                                                 |
|--------|---------------------|-------------------------------------------------------------|
|        | [Any](`typing.Any`) | The C-Map's output at this instant, or None if unreachable. |

### get_unit { #timetoalign.TimeStamp.get_unit }

```python
TimeStamp.get_unit(unit)
```

Get coordinate converted to a specific unit.

Works with any map registered by ``add_conversion_map``, called
directly regardless of concrete type (``TableMap``, ``ScalarMap``,
``LinearMap``, ``InterpolationMap``, ...).

Searches the source and every descendant/member timeline for a C-Map
with this target unit, evaluating it at the timeline's own coordinate.
A timestamp therefore surfaces unit conversions registered at any
depth of the hierarchy, not just on the queried timeline.

#### Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name   | Type         | Description                     | Default    |
|--------|--------------|---------------------------------|------------|
| unit   | \'TimeUnit\' | The target unit for conversion. | _required_ |

#### Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type                     | Description                                          |
|--------|--------------------------|------------------------------------------------------|
|        | [float](`float`) \| None | Converted coordinate, or None if no C-Map available. |

### to_dict { #timetoalign.TimeStamp.to_dict }

```python
TimeStamp.to_dict(include_children=True, conversion_units=None)
```

Materialize all coordinates as a dictionary.

#### Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name             | Type                                                                             | Description                                                                                                                                                                                   | Default   |
|------------------|----------------------------------------------------------------------------------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|-----------|
| include_children | [bool](`bool`)                                                                   | Include child/member timeline coordinates.                                                                                                                                                    | `True`    |
| conversion_units | [list](`list`)\[\'TimeUnit\'\] \| [Literal](`typing.Literal`)\[\'all\'\] \| None | C-Map conversions to include. - None: No C-Map conversions - "all": Every C-Map across the subtree, of every kind   (unit conversions, labels, structured values) - list: Specific units only | `None`    |

#### Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type                                                | Description                                             |
|--------|-----------------------------------------------------|---------------------------------------------------------|
|        | [dict](`dict`)\[[str](`str`), [Any](`typing.Any`)\] | Dict mapping timeline_id/unit_name/cmap-label to value. |
